chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever recites 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' ten times, Allah will build for him a house in Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas ten times?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) teaching that reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas ten times builds a house in Paradise, emphasizing the Surah's unique status as equivalent to one-third of the Quran. This practice highlights the Shia emphasis on the spiritual potency of Tawhid (monotheism) and the merit of consistent dhikr in securing eternal reward. The narration serves as both a spiritual incentive and a theological reminder of the centrality of divine unity in Islamic devotion.
